answer: Each agent maintains a unique non-shareable dune of sequential memory-hard state that advances only under a live gale of random probes at its exclusive vertex. A Sybil farm with N clones must replay the full dune advance for every head in series; work scales linearly with N and cannot be pooled, so 200 fakes cost about 200 times the wall-clock of one honest agent. An honest participant pays a single dune update per epoch; matching gale intermediates slash the joint vertex cluster weight.
